description: What a process and everything it started cost, read at one sample, on the scale of system.machine/v1.

pid.description: The process measured: the anchor of the flow's subscribers.

processes.description: The process and its descendants at the sample.

usage.description: CPU time the tree took since the previous sample, percent of all online cores, like cpu.usage of system.machine/v1. Two decimals. Children that ended in between count, each process once.

usage_one_core.description: The same time in percent of one core, like top: 250 is two and a half cores. Two decimals.

anon_mib.description: Sum of the anonymous resident memories of the tree, MiB: its share of the machine's used memory, total_mib - available_mib of system.machine/v1.
